mainEntity.name: Should my pool contracting website focus on SEO or paid advertising?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both SEO and paid advertising (PPC) are valuable for pool contractors, but they serve different purposes. SEO provides long-term, sustainable organic traffic and builds authority over time. It's a foundational strategy for consistent visibility. Paid advertising offers immediate visibility and targeted traffic, allowing you to quickly reach potential clients for specific promotions or urgent services. The optimal approach often involves a combination of both: using PPC for immediate leads while continuously building your organic presence through SEO for sustained growth. Your budget and immediate goals will influence the balance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Both SEO and paid advertising are valuable. SEO offers long-term organic traffic and authority, while paid ads provide immediate, targeted visibility. A combined strategy is often most effective.
